scope: Actual Jobs/Market components with synthetic Auth/database and navigation adapters. No hosted authentication, real provider, payment, Storage, or physical-device acceptance.
checks: Jobs uses real named destinations, line icons and independent card actions
Job search, remote filtering and empty-state reset change actual rendered results
Failed job save rolls back without navigation; retry updates Saved jobs and unsave removes it
Cancelling native job sharing does not silently copy the link
Application review and Escape keep résumé and text local, with focus returned to Review
Application upload failure retains the draft and repeated confirmation sends only one application
Application status route and withdrawal require a separate review before the versioned RPC
Jobs read failures have a working in-place retry
Market filters validate ranges, Cancel makes no query change, and Apply changes actual listing results
Saved and Selling views connect to actual records, and saved removal updates the grid
Market alert failures preserve input, success and removal confirm real adapter writes, and Escape exits
Product gallery supports keyboard selection and meaningful image descriptions
Offer editing and cancellation send nothing; a failed send remains reviewable before retry
Order request review is local and Edit keeps quantity and delivery notes
Lost order response preserves the immutable request; retry confirms one existing order without payment
Order actions require review, retain failures, and submit the current order version
Order history has a working close path and retains the actual event timeline
Listing reports open a named focused dialog and Cancel makes no report RPC
Seller actions require review, refuse an unconfirmed update, and confirm one ownership-bound retry
Switching accounts during an order request clears private drafts and contains the late result
Signed-out job saving opens the actual sign-in destination
Market stays readable in Dim with the real appearance control
Jobs, applications, Market, product and orders fit a 390px screen without horizontal overflow
Mobile review keeps the footer reachable and native dialog focus contained
Warm Jobs preserves filters, loaded and empty results, saved changes and account boundaries
